summary: Mergeable with minor issues related to code style and documentation.

issues.description: Code style: The added condition in the if statement could be simplified using a more Pythonic way.
Documentation: The updated code section in the __init__.py file lacks a docstring explaining the modification made to the modify_sys_path function.
Insufficient tests: Although the automated tests pass, it would be beneficial to add more comprehensive tests to ensure the new condition handles various edge cases effectively.
